prompt: This code is in a different package from Animal. Why won't it compile?
choices: Animal must be public to be imported
protected members can only be accessed from a different package via a subclass, not from an unrelated class
legs must be declared static to be accessed by Test
System.out.println cannot print int from another package
explanation: Protected access from a different package is only allowed within a subclass context. Test is unrelated to Animal — it is not a subclass. Fix: either make legs public, or have Test extend Animal.
